slice: full acceptance tracking registry and honest gate runner over nine systems, 40 modules, V/S/FL
purpose: Materialize the 40-module requirement index and the V01-V27/S01-S08/FL01-FL08 indexes into a machine-readable acceptance registry, and add a gate runner that derives every status from evidence only, keeps executed/passed at zero where nothing ran, and refuses to promote tooling or limited evidence into a product pass.

implementation.registry: 12 regions / 40 modules from 架构与设计/A方案全景/目录.md with requirement source, nine-system mapping, known code paths and product test ids (existence-checked), oracle, committed evidence source ids, blocked resources and limitations; statuses are evidence-derived only: limited-only / blocked / not_covered / unknown.
implementation.vSFl: V01-V27 keep the original thresholds and numbering (14 resource-blocked, 12 limited-evidence, 1 not-covered, 0 passed); S01-S08/FL01-FL08 are read from the H0c skeleton with synthetic-fixture-only-not-run and canUseForBusinessAcceptance=false propagated verbatim; system<->module<->V/S/FL mapping completeness is asserted.
implementation.runner: scripts/harness/acceptance.mjs reads traceability/selfproof/manifest/fl-coverage plus the registry and emits acceptance-report.json/.md with per-system/module/V/S/FL status in the non-authoritative tooling layer; planned=92, executed=passed=failed=0, unknown/blocked/notRun separated, gate always incomplete and completeNineSystems=false, nine blocked resources, cannotClaim text; honesty tests reject tooling_ready/limited-only as pass, removing unknown/skipped/notRun from denominators, forged completion and H0c flag upgrades.
implementation.tests: 8 tests: registry completeness, unique 40 modules, unmapped -> unknown, negative promotion rejection, honest denominators, deterministic output plus CLI, no product/network imports, documentation contract.
